about: Files a carried PR #243 test's code reads by its address, which the import closure does not follow, so no lane carried them: they come byte for byte from the tag old-trillion-before-worker-retire to the place the moved code reads them. docs/pr243-deleted-tests.json names the tests they let run.

calls.means: This repository is public and holds made-up data only: a real person's first name used as a test's sample owner becomes a made-up one. Nothing else in the file changes.

groups.joins_tool: the rules file its wake-stopped-chats handler reads by its address (harness/wake-stopped-chats.json): the handler moved, the file it reads did not, so the handler and its test stopped at ENOENT
